briefing: Minnesota's fraud scandal has now surpassed $9 billion in alleged losses across multiple programs. The Feeding Our Future case alone involves $250 million in stolen federal child nutrition funds, with 70+ individuals charged and 28+ convicted. Additional investigations continue into CCAP daycare fraud, Housing Stabilization Services, and Autism Services (EIDBI). Federal and state prosecutors are coordinating on what has become the largest pandemic fraud investigation in U.S. history.
